name: reticle
description: Runtime UI evidence + action harness for Android and iOS apps. Read the live view / accessibility / Compose-semantics / SwiftUI / WebView DOM tree, resolve exact selectors (CSS and per-phrase tap regions), drive real input (adb on Android; CoreSimulator HID on an iOS simulator, in-process synthesized touches on an iOS device), reach another process's UI on a real iOS device through the out-of-process system channel, record before/after action traces, mock and replay network traffic, live-patch UI properties without rebuilding, and inject the runtime into an app that does not link the agent.
